title.zh: 可选择 Windows 更新的安装位置

description.en: Before installing an update, you can keep the current folder or choose another drive.
description.zh: 安装更新前，可保留当前目录，也可选择其他磁盘。

description.en: Theme, language, and version are visible in the sidebar. The API connection check, theme menu, and quit confirmation have cleaner layouts.
description.zh: 侧边栏直接显示主题、语言和版本；API 连接测试、主题菜单与退出确认界面也更清晰。

title.en: Choose a working folder on any drive
title.zh: 可在任意磁盘选择工作目录

description.en: The Workspace folder picker now shows all available Windows drives, not just C:.
description.zh: 工作区的文件夹选择器现在会显示 Windows 上所有可用的磁盘，不再局限于 C 盘。

title.en: Windows updates start on the first try
title.zh: Windows 更新首次点击即可安装

description.en: The installer now starts after OpenAgents fully exits, avoiding an update that only closes the app.
description.zh: 安装程序现在会在 OpenAgents 完全退出后启动，避免只退出应用却未开始更新。
